response.sql:
WITH per_site AS (
  SELECT s.zoneref, st.entrystat,
         AVG(s.memusagegb) AS avg_ram,
         AVG(1.0 * s.procgpu / NULLIF(s.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_gpu_cpu_ratio
  FROM scanprocessing AS s
  JOIN sites AS st ON st.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
  WHERE s.memusagegb > 60.8
  GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.entrystat
)
SELECT entrystat,
       AVG(avg_ram) AS avg_of_site_avg_ram,
       AVG(avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) AS avg_of_site_avg_gpu_cpu_ratio
FROM per_site
GROUP BY entrystat;

assumptions.assumption: A missing CPU value or zero CPU makes the GPU/CPU ratio undefined, so that run is excluded from the ratio average; SQLite AVG ignores these NULL ratios. A site with no defined ratio contributes no value to that status's ratio average.
